pilot_closure_criteria: Exact native/metadata/method identity pinned and current inputs revalidated
Complete justified bytes/ranges and CFG; bounded inspection windows clearly distinguished from full body proof
Signature/ABI, arguments/return, register and field/layout meanings grounded in original evidence
All relevant memory effects, state transitions, invalid inputs, termination and exception paths accounted for or explicitly limited through accepted external contracts
All relevant indirect/callback/generic call targets resolved; required unknown semantic paths prevent completion
Meaningful mutation/contract checks plus independent reviewer verifies evidence and acceptance
Queue submission and review occur only after actual technical acceptance; distinct actor names alone are not independent review
parent_closure_criteria: Full inventory-derived required universe reconciled, including methods absent from initial five pilots
All obligatory methods have traceable children or justified shared/external classification
T022/T023/T024 dependencies actually satisfy their own acceptance
All discovered children accepted independently and hashes current
Aggregate coverage reports remaining unknowns honestly; no relevant body/indirect/effect gaps disguised as completed methods
limits: No game execution, emulation, Unity work, provider opening, queue mutation or producer rerun was performed in this audit.
No conclusion about full runtime parity or all game methods follows from inventory counts.
Review did not inspect every opcode of all five methods or independently establish complete CFG/body ranges.
Report reflects queue revision at audit time; later queue/source changes require new hash checks.

readiness_producer_review.review_type: Source review plus isolated temporary-root mutation fixtures; no live queue or producer output changed.
readiness_producer_review.counts_and_certification_verdict: Supported: each unique inventory image/token is counted once, null pointers remain unclassified, child states are not semantic proof, can_close_t025 is unconditionally false. Scope correctly limited to Assembly-CSharp MethodDefs.

findings.observation: Index is parsed from one read but input hash is computed from a later read. Queue also re-read for hash after one stability comparison. Report can attribute old analyzed data to new input hashes.
findings.fixture_result: During reconcile, changed index fixture method name Before->After. run succeeded; ledger retains Before while report records hash of After.
findings.required_resolution: Capture both input byte snapshots once, parse and hash those exact bytes, and compare both current inputs with snapshots before publishing. Preserve claimed revision as snapshot revision.

findings.observation: Registry is replaced before input-stability validation. A detected queue change aborts report generation after already altering registry, leaving previous report/new registry or unreferenced output.
findings.fixture_result: Set registry to OLD_REGISTRY and mutate queue revision inside reconcile. run raises queue changed as expected but registry no longer equals OLD_REGISTRY.
findings.required_resolution: Validate input snapshots before publishing outputs. For report+registry consistency, use content-addressed/exclusive generation registry and publish referencing report last, or clearly state per-file atomicity only. Avoid overwriting a registry referenced by a previous accepted manifest.

limitations: Mutation fixtures use temporary directories and synthetic method metadata; they test IO consistency, not shipped method semantics.
The producer is an audit and intentionally cannot certify T025; findings do not suggest turning its can_close gate true.
